newsitem.title: USA: CFTC proposes rule changes for securities transfer.
newsitem.headline: CFTC proposes rule changes for securities transfer.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission proposed rule changes on Friday that would allow commission merchants to make direct transfers of certain securities in and out of safekeeping accounts.
Currently, futures commission merchants can use only direct transfers of cash to a customer's segregated account.

In a notice published in the Federal Register, the CFTC said its proposal would require any transfer of securities to include a security identification number to provide an audit trail. The agency said it would accept public comments on the proposal through April 21.
